description:
Download results for a completed bulk validation file.
When to use: After file_status shows completion, fetch the results CSV.
Parameters: fileId — bulk validation id; downloadType (optional) — phase_1, phase_2 or combined; activityData (optional) — include activity columns when supported.
CREDITS: Does not spend validation credits.

activityData.description: Include activity data columns (sent as activity_data).

downloadType.description: Which results to download: phase_1, phase_2 or combined (sent as download_type).

name: get_file
title: Download validation results
